name: source-audit-consistency-checker
purpose: Prevent sourcing coverage metrics from overstating real coverage when job-sources, source-audit and persisted candidates disagree.
checks: every checked source family has a source-audit record with checkedAt/status
verified hit counts require a canonical or directly verifiable public detail
promotion counts reconcile to persisted stable IDs or an explicit promotion-ready debt record
non-Profesia percentage is computed from canonical source family rather than mirrors
Facebook blocked/limited status can never be converted to verified coverage without a directly verifiable public hiring post
location-eligible hit counts include only ba-area or remote-ok; unknown and reject-distance are excluded

sourceDiversity.rule: A blocked or zero-yield family remains visible in the audit and is not silently counted as successful coverage.
